title: Analytics number formatting
responsibility: Formats assessment proportions and counts for analytics views.

inputs.name: analyticsDisplay.value
inputs.description: Fraction to display as a percentage, or null when no assessments exist.

inputs.name: analyticsCount.value
inputs.description: Count to format using the runtime locale.

outputs.name: analyticsDisplay
outputs.description: Rounded whole percentage, or No assessments for null.
